verdict_reason: Critical schema gate is fixed, but two new Majors remain: openapi.generate still early-returns past all assertions, and assertSchemaPropertyNamesMatch fails open on missing components/properties.

todos.issue: Regeneration was moved to a separate @EnabledIfSystemProperty test (partial fix for item 159), but apiDocsMatchTheCommittedArtifactAndTheLockedContract still early-returns when -Dopenapi.generate=true — now without writing the artifact — so the staleness and divergence gates still silently disappear on that flag.
todos.fix: Remove the early-return branch entirely from the assertion test; regeneration already lives in regenerateCommittedOpenApiArtifact.

todos.issue: New assertSchemaPropertyNamesMatch fails open: returns without asserting when either doc lacks components (lines 274-276), and skips a schema's property-key check unless BOTH sides expose a Map 'properties' node (lines 286-291) — so components missing, or locked-with-properties vs live-without, leaves the new Critical schema gate green
todos.fix: Assert components/schemas are non-null (AssertJ), and treat a missing/non-Map properties node as an empty map so property-key-set equality always runs
